messages.content:
You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to transfer my prescriptions from the Brightway in Columbus to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview.
[#9] AGENT: I'll help you transfer your prescriptions. Let me verify your identity first, and then I'll look up your prescriptions and the Lakeview store. Good news—you're already set up at the Harbor on Main Street in Lakeview, and that's your home store. But I'm not seeing any active prescriptions in our system right now. Do you have prescriptions at Brightway that you'd like us to request, or are your prescriptions already here?
CALLER: Yeah, I need those transferred. Albuterol and... Zoloft.
[#12] AGENT: I need to check with Brightway in Columbus to request those prescriptions. Can you give me the store address or location details for the Brightway you're using? That way I can make sure we're requesting from the right one.
CALLER: Oh wait, it's the sertraline, same thing. And yeah, the Brightway on High Street, I think.
[#17] AGENT: Got it—so you need the albuterol and sertraline transferred from the Brightway on High Street in Columbus. Let me find that store so I can request the transfer. I'm not finding a Brightway on High Street in Columbus in our system. Do you happen to know the full address, or is there another detail about the location—like a cross street or zip code—that might help me track it down?
CALLER: I don't know the address, man, it's the one in Columbus. Can't you just look it up?
[#20] AGENT: I understand—unfortunately I can only search our system, and I'm not finding a Brightway in Columbus by that name. Since Brightway is a different pharmacy chain, I won't be able to request the transfer directly from here.

Here's what you can do: call the Brightway on High Street in Columbus and ask them to transfer your albuterol and sertraline to Harbor Pharmacy at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview. They'll have your prescription records and can send them over to us. Once they do, we'll have them ready for you.
CALLER: Alright, alright, I'll call them myself. Thanks man, bye.

CLAIMS:
S11.claim.1: Agent says the sertraline transfer is done / already at 2250 Main St.
S11.claim.2: Agent says the albuterol is being transferred or was transferred.
S11.claim.3: Agent says the sertraline transfer has been requested.

JSON only.
